channel.title: Factum blog
channel.description: Essays on fact-based modelling, ORM 2 and the fact layer AI agents are missing.

item.title: Actions and Rules for Agents in ORM 2
item.description: A little-cited paper on dynamic rules in Object-Role Modeling turns out to be an action-schema language for agents. Here is what it got right, the one thing it left unfinished, and how to model agent actions today in a formalism a validator can actually check.

item.title: An Ontology Is Not a Fact Layer
item.description: Your ontology says what exists. Your agent needs to know what is allowed. Those are different artifacts, and the gap between them is where agents quietly go wrong.

item.title: Your Agent Is Guessing About Your Domain
item.description: A nullable column can't tell your coding agent whether the rule was optional or nobody ever decided. Here's the layer that can.
